Nepal flood death toll nears 600 as rescue efforts continue.
More than 3,700 people have been rescued as crews search for survivors following Wednesday's massive flood along the Nepal-China border. At least 579 people have been killed in Nepal and five in Tibet, while roughly 2,500 remain missing; authorities are monitoring
